python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values in millions
value_2011 = 135030
value_2019 = 35810

# Number of years
n = 2019 - 2011

# CAGR = (Ending Value / Beginning Value)^(1/n) - 1
cagr = (value_2019 / value_2011)**(1/n) - 1

# Annual decay factor = 1 + CAGR
decay_factor = 1 + cagr

# Arc elasticity using midpoint percentage change
# Arc elasticity = ((y2 - y1) / ((y1 + y2)/2)) / ((x2 - x1) / ((x1 + x2)/2))
# Here x1=2011, x2=2019, y1=135030, y2=35810
x1, x2 = 2011, 2019
y1, y2 = value_2011, value_2019

# Midpoint percentage change for y
pct_change_y = (y2 - y1) / ((y1 + y2) / 2)

# Midpoint percentage change for x  
pct_change_x = (x2 - x1) / ((x1 + x2) / 2)

# Arc elasticity
arc_elasticity = pct_change_y / pct_change_x

print(f"CAGR: {cagr:.6f}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {decay_factor:.6f}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {arc_elasticity:.6f}")

# Round to 3 decimal places
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places:")
print(f"CAGR: {round(cagr, 3)}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {round(decay_factor, 3)}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")
EOF
